summary: Two small polish items: (1) DuckingConfig.ptt_auto_manual_enabled makes PTT-driven Auto/Manual ownership optional, default true (preserves r0082 behavior); disabled means PTT never changes Auto/Manual and operator-owned Manual is never touched. (2) UITheme branding cleanup -- logo is Admin-header-only (bundled IsadoraAir fallback), station_logo is the ordinary front-end/login/welcome brand, no more stacked logos.
